ACT VI OF 2007
ACT VI OF 2007
BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER'S
AND DEPUTY
SPEAKER'S (SALARIES
ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2007
An Act further to amend
the Balochistan Speaker's
and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (V
of 1975)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
18th September, 2007]
No.PAB/Legis:V(45)/2007, dated 18-9-2007.---The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill 2007. Bill No. 9 of 2007 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
on 11th August, 2007 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan
on 11th September, 2007 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title, and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No.PAB/Legis:V(45)/2007, dated 18-9-2007.---The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill 2007. Bill No. 9 of 2007 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
on 11th August, 2007 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan
on 11th September, 2007 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
2. Insertion of new section 6-C.---In the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, after section 6-B the following new
section 6-C shall be inserted namely:--
"6-C Other Facilities.--On the
dissolution of Provincial Assembly, the Speaker including current Speaker who
might have completed minimum 4 years of the tenure as such, shall for the life
time be entitled to the following facilities at Government expenses:--
(a) one driver;
(b) free access
to Provincial Government Rest Houses in the Country;
(c) free
installation of official telephone at residence and utilization thereof to the
extent of Rs.2000 per month:
Provided that such
facilities shall be discontinued if the Speaker holds any government office
during such period.
